blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Joint-embedding self-supervised learning typically combines an invariance objective across augmented views with additional mechanisms to prevent representational collapse. These objectives are often applied after a projection head, while downstream tasks use the backbone representation before the projector. We find that this mismatch does not necessarily prevent dimensional collapse in the backbone, which can retain low effective rank and potentially limit downstream transfer. To address this, we introduce SACReg , a spectral anti-collapse regularizer motivated by an analysis of λ \lambda -balance, which captures the relative scale of weight matrices across layers. In a two-layer linear network, we show that (i) λ \lambda -balance prevents collapse, and (ii) our regularizer applied to the backbone induces λ \lambda -balance. In the nonlinear case, this regularizer leads to anti-collapse as well and, in realistic architectures on ImageNet100, it empirically increases the representations’ ranks. We apply SACReg to JEPA and propose λ \lambda -JEPA, which improves over LeJEPA and VISReg on ImageNet-1k classification and in average linear-probe transfer performance across eight downstream image datasets. On video self-supervised learning, λ \lambda -JEPA improves over LeVJEPA and V-JEPA 2 on the Something-Something-v2 and Kinetics-400 benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/berkerdemirel/lambda-jepa .
blocks.zh: 联合组合的自我监督学习通常将各种扩大观点的不一致性目标与防止代表性崩溃的其他机制结合起来。 这些目标往往在投影头之后应用,而下游任务则在投影仪之前使用骨干代表. 我们发现,这种不匹配并不一定能防止骨干中的维度崩溃,这可以保持低效级别,并可能限制下游转移. 为了解决这个问题,我们引入了SACReg,一种光谱反螺旋调节器,其动机是分析QQ\lambda - 平衡,它捕捉到跨层重量矩阵的相对尺度. 在双层线性网络中,我们显示 (一) \\ lambda - 平衡防止崩溃, (二) 我们的调节器应用于骨干上诱导 \\\ lambda - 平衡. 在非线性情况下,这种常态化也会导致反折叠,在ImageNet100上的现实架构中,经验性地增加了代表的排名. 我们把SACReg应用到JEPA,并提议\\lambda-JEPA,它比LeJEPA和VISReg在ImageNet-1k分类上以及平均线性探测传输性能在8个下游图像数据集上有所改进. 校对:Soup 代码见https://github.com/berkerdemirel/lambda-jepa。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Self-supervised learning aims to learn transferable representations from unlabeled data without requiring manual annotations ( Jing and Tian, 2021 ) . In computer vision, joint-embedding self-supervised learning (JE-SSL) has become one of the most promising approaches, encouraging representations of related views or regions of an image to agree while additional mechanisms prevent representational collapse ( Jing et al., 2022 ; Bardes et al., 2022 ) . These mechanisms include using contrastive negatives ( Chen et al., 2020 ; He et al., 2020 ) , asymmetric teacher-student training ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Grill et al., 2020 ) and explicit anti-collapse regularization ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ; Bardes et al., 2022 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 自我监督的学习旨在从无标签的数据中学习可转移的表示,而不需要人工说明(Jing and Tian, 2021). 在计算机愿景中,联合嵌入的自我监督学习(JE-SSL)已成为最有希望的方法之一,鼓励表达相关观点或图像区域达成一致,同时增加机制防止代表性崩溃(Jing等人,2022年;Bardes等人,2022年)。 这些机制包括使用对比性负数(Chen等人,2020年;He等人,2020年),不对称师生培训(Caron等人,2021年;Zhou等人,2022年;Grill等人,2020年)和明确的反碰撞正规化(Balestriero and LeCun,2025年;Bardes等人,2022年;Wu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en:
JE-SSL methods typically optimize a projected representation during pretraining, while downstream tasks discard the non-linear projection head and use the backbone representation instead. These two representation spaces can differ substantially in both geometry and downstream performance ( Bordes et al., 2023 ) . In contrastive self-supervised learning, this has also been studied through dimensional collapse, where learned representations span only a lower dimensional part of the available feature space ( Jing et al., 2022 ) . We observe an analogous phenomenon in explicitly regularized JE-SSL methods. Although their anti-collapse objectives successfully maintain high rank projected representations, the corresponding backbone representations can remain low rank.
This matters for task-agnostic representation learning, where different downstream tasks can benefit from different invariances ( Ericsson et al., 2021 ; Tian et al., 2020b ) . Dimensional collapse in the backbone can therefore limit transfer by reducing the set of feature directions available for downstream tasks. Consistent with this view, effective rank has been shown to predict downstream performance in JE-SSL ( Garrido et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
JE-SSL方法一般在预训期间优化预测的表示,而下游任务则抛弃非线性投影头,代之以使用主干表示. 这两个代表空间在几何学和下游性能上可以有很大的不同(Bordes等人,2023年). 在对比性的自我监督学习中,这也通过维度崩溃来研究,在那里,学到的表达方式只跨越了现有特征空间中一个较低的维度部分(Jing等人,2022年). 我们从明确规范的JE-SSL方法中观察到类似现象。 虽然他们的反冲突目标成功地维持了高等级的预期代表,但相应的骨干代表可以保持低级别。
这对任务不可知性表现学习很重要,因为不同下游任务可以从不同的偏差中受益(Ericsson等人,2021年;Tian等人,2020年b)。 因此,主干部的维度崩溃可以通过减少下游任务可用的特征方向来限制转移. 与这一观点相一致的是,在JE-SSL(Garrido等人,2023年)中,已经显示有效的级别可以预测下游的业绩。

blocks.en:
The rank of learned representations has been studied extensively in the feature-learning literature, with prior work linking representation rank to distinct learning regimes in linear and nonlinear networks ( Saxe et al., 2014 ; Atanasov et al., 2022 ) .
Building on this perspective, we analyze a two-layer linear model with λ \lambda -balance initialization, which captures the relative scale of adjacent layers, and connects it to representation rank. The resulting spectral anti-collapse mechanism motivates a covariance regularizer for nonlinear networks, applied directly to the backbone features to restore their representation rank. In other words, our λ \lambda -balance theory prescribes both the form of the regularizer and where it should be applied. We then apply it accordingly to JE-SSL in a method we call λ \lambda -JEPA, using view-averaged backbone representations to prevent collapse and promote variation across images (see Figure 6 ). In controlled experiments, we show that λ \lambda -JEPA improves class-relevant separation while preserving augmentation dependent variation. At larger scale, it outperforms both LeJEPA ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) and VISReg ( Wu et al., 2026 ) on ImageNet-1K ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) trained from scratch, with performance approaching DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) in both linear probing and transfer learning. The same approach applies off the shelf to video JEPA models, where λ \lambda -JEPA trained from scratch outperforms V-JEPA 2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) and LeVJEPA ( Kuhn et al., 2026 ) on Something-Something-v2 ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) and Kinetics-400 ( Kay et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh:
在专题学习文献中广泛研究了学习表现的等级,以前的工作将表现等级与线性和非线性网络中不同的学习制度联系起来(Saxe等人,2014年;Atanasov等人,2022年)。
在这个角度上,我们分析一个带有QQ\lambda - 平衡初始化的双层线性模型,它捕捉到相邻层的相对尺度,并将其与代表级别联系起来. 由此形成的光谱反碰撞机制激发了非线性网络的共变调节器,直接应用于骨干特征,以恢复其代表级别. 换句话说,我们的 \\ lambda - 平衡理论 既规定了正则器的形式, 也规定了它应该应用的地方。 然后,我们用我们称之为\\lambda-JEPA的方法,对JE-SSL进行相应的应用,使用平均视图的骨干表示来防止崩塌和促进图像的变异(见图6)。 在受控实验中,我们显示\\lambda-JEPA改进了与类相关的分离,同时保留增强依赖性变异. 在更大的规模上,它在ImageNet-1K(Russakovsky等人,2015年)上的LeJEPA(Balestriero和LeCun,2025年)和VISReg(Wu等人,2026年)都从零开始训练,在线性探测和转移学习上的表现接近DINO(Caron等人,2021年)。 同样的方法也适用于视频JEPA模型,其中\\lambda-JEPA从头到尾的训练优于V-JEPA2(Asran等人,2025年)和LeVJEPA(Kuhn等人,2026年)的Something-v2(Goyal等人,2017年)和Kinetics-400(Kay等人,2017年)。

blocks.en: We summarize our main contributions as: • We show that standard JE-SSL methods designed to prevent collapse in the projected representation do not ensure a high-rank backbone, potentially limiting its representational capacity for downstream tasks. • We derive SACReg, a spectral anti-collapse regularizer that guarantees encoder non-collapse in a two-layer linear network, motivating encoder-side spectral regularization. We extend this to nonlinear encoders by directly regularizing representation covariance and apply it to JE-SSL using view-averaged backbone representations to prevent collapse and promote variation across images. • We propose λ \lambda -JEPA, a standalone SSL method that applies SACReg to both the backbone and projected representations. Across image JE-SSL benchmarks, λ \lambda -JEPA improves frozen transfer while remaining competitive on ImageNet-1k classification, and extends to video SSL with large gains on temporal recognition.

blocks.en: 2 Problem and related works
blocks.zh: 2 问题和相关工程

blocks.en: Figure 1: Backbone and loss space geometry for explicitly regularized JE-SSL methods. The projection head changes both pairwise similarities and RankMe.
blocks.zh: 图1:明确规范化JE-SSL方法的背骨和损失空间几何. 投影头既会改变对称的相似性,也会改变RankMe.

blocks.en: Modern joint-embedding self-supervised learning (JE-SSL) methods differ primarily in how they avoid collapsed solutions. We focus on a family of explicitly regularized methods (VICReg ( Bardes et al., 2022 ) , LeJEPA ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) , VISReg ( Wu et al., 2026 ) ). In the projected space, VICReg controls feature variance and covariance, while LeJEPA regularizes the embedding distribution toward an isotropic Gaussian. VISReg similarly combines variance regularization with an additional distributional constraint. Following the use of projection heads in SimCLR ( Chen et al., 2020 ) , these objectives act after a non-linear projection head, which is discarded for downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 现代联合嵌入的自我监督学习(JE-SSL)方法主要在如何避免崩溃的解决方案上有所不同. 我们侧重于一套明确规范的方法(VICReg(Bardes等人,2022年),LeJEPA(Balestriro和LeCun,2025年),VISReg(Wu等人,2026年)。 在预测的空间中,VICReg控制特征差异和共变,而LeJEPA则将嵌入式分布规范化,朝向异热带高斯人. VISREG同样将差异正规化与额外的分配制约结合起来. 在SimCLR(Chen等人,2020年)使用投影头后,这些目标在非线性投影头之后起作用,该投影头因下游任务而丢弃.

We focus on a specific consequence of this separation: in these explicitly regularized
methods, anti-collapse constraints are imposed on 𝐳 \mathbf{z} , yet with nonlinear
projectors, preventing dimensional collapse in 𝐳 \mathbf{z} does not in general prevent it in the backbone representation 𝐡 \mathbf{h} . 1 1 1 For example, let 𝐡 = ( X , 0 ) ⊤ \mathbf{h}=(X,0)^{\top} with X X uniform on { − 1 , 0 , 1 } \{-1,0,1\} , and let p ⁡ ( 𝐡 ) = ( h 1 , | h 1 | ) ⊤ p(\mathbf{h})=(h_{1},|h_{1}|)^{\top} . Then Cov ⁡ ( 𝐡 ) \operatorname{Cov}(\mathbf{h}) has rank one, while Cov ⁡ ( p ⁡ ( 𝐡 ) ) = diag ⁡ ( 2 / 3 , 2 / 9 ) \operatorname{Cov}(p(\mathbf{h}))=\operatorname{diag}(2/3,2/9) has full rank. . Figure 1 shows how two key aspects of explicitly regularized JE-SSL methods change across the projection head: (i) agreement between augmented views and (ii) prevention of representational collapse. Positive pairs remain highly aligned in both the backbone and projected spaces. In contrast, different images have very similar representations in the backbone, indicating substantial concentration. The same discrepancy appears in representation rank. RankMe ( Garrido et al., 2023 ) measures how evenly variance is distributed across feature directions and is typically higher in the projected space, whereas backbone remains low rank, especially for VISReg and LeJEPA. For task-agnostic representation learning, low rank backbones can be restrictive because different downstream tasks may rely on different feature directions ( Ericsson et al., 2021 ; Tian et al., 2020b ) . Consistently, Garrido et al. (2023) have shown that it correlates with downstream performance in JE-SSL, motivating backbone-level anti-collapse regularization.

blocks.en:
The question of what determines the rank of learned representations has been studied extensively in the feature learning literature which has so far had little contact with SSL but offers directly relevant tools.
In particular, deep linear networks provide a tractable setting for studying these effects. Despite their linear end-to-end mapping, their factorized parameterization induces nonlinear optimization dynamics ( Baldi and Hornik, 1989 ; Fukumizu, 1998 ; Saxe et al., 2014 ; Du et al., 2019 ; Jacot et al., 2018 ; Chizat et al., 2019 ; Braun et al., 2022 ) and captures phenomena observed in nonlinear networks ( Saxe et al., 2019 ; Kunin et al., 2024 ; Nam et al., 2025 ; Anguita et al., 2026 ) . Initialization plays a central role in these dynamics: small initializations favor low-rank or sparse solutions, whereas appropriate large-scale limits yield kernel-like behavior ( Saxe et al., 2014 ; Gunasekar et al., 2018 ; Chizat and Bach, 2020 ; Woodworth et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2021 ) .
In nonlinear networks, initialization scale likewise influences the learning regime ( Luo et al., 2021 ; Atanasov et al., 2022 ) .
Beyond overall initialization scale, the relative scales of adjacent layers, as studied through λ \lambda -balanced initializations, also influence learning dynamics and implicit bias ( Azulay et al., 2021 ; Kunin et al., 2024 ; Dominé et al., 2025 ; Jarvis et al., 2025 ) . Their consequences for representation rank, however, remain less characterized, particularly in the nonlinear regime and in larger scale networks. Our work addresses this gap by investigating how layer balance shapes representation rank and using these insights to derive a regularizer that prevents collapse in the backbone representations of SSL models.
blocks.zh:
在迄今为止与SSL几乎没有联系但提供直接相关工具的特写学习文献中,广泛研究了如何确定学习表现的级别问题。
特别是,深线网络为研究这些效应提供了一个可操作的设置. 尽管其线性端对端映射,其因子化参数化诱导非线性优化动态(Baldi and Hornik,1989年;Fukumizu,1998年;Saxe等人,2014年;Du等人,2019年;Jacot等人,2018年;Chizat等人,2019年;Braun等人,2022年),并捕捉非线性网络中观测到的现象(Saxe等人,2019年;Kunin等人,2024年;Nam等人,2025年;Anguita等人,2026年). 初始化在这些动态中起着核心作用:小初始化有利于低级或稀疏的解决方案,而适当的大规模极限生成类似内核的行为(Saxe等人,2014年;Gunasekar等人,2018年;Chizat和Bach,2020年;Woodworth等人,2020年;Li等人,2021年).
在非线性网络中,初始化尺度同样影响学习制度(Luo等人,2021年;Atanasov等人,2022年)。
在总体初始化规模之外,通过\\ lambda-均衡初始化研究的相邻层的相对尺度也影响学习动态和隐含偏差(Azulay等人,2021年;Kuin等人,2024年;Dominé等人,2025年;Jarvis等人,2025年)。 然而,它们对代表级别的影响仍然不那么明显,特别是在非线性制度和规模较大的网络中。 我们的工作解决了这一差距,调查层间平衡如何塑造代表级别,并利用这些见解得出一种规范化方法,防止SSL模型的骨干代表崩溃。

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
Our goal is to prevent collapse in the backbone representations retained for downstream transfer. We first study a tractable two-layer linear network, where we show that negative layer balance yields a non-collapse guarantee
and motivates an encoder-side spectral regularizer.
We extend this principle to nonlinear encoders by directly regularizing representation covariance, then apply it to JE-SSL on view-averaged backbone representations to promote variation across images. Figure 6 illustrates the resulting λ \lambda -JEPA objective and the placement of SACReg in the backbone and projected spaces.
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是防止为下游转移而保留的骨干代表的崩溃。 我们首先研究一个可牵引的双层线性网络, 在那里,我们显示负层平衡 产生一个不折叠的保证
并激发编码器侧光谱调节器。
我们将此原则延伸至非线性编码器,直接规范表示共性,然后将其应用到JE-SSL的视图平均主干表示上,以促进图像的变异. 图6说明了由此产生的\\lambda-JEPA目标,以及将SACReg置于主干和预测空间。

blocks.en: 3.1 Deriving a spectral anti-collapse mechanism in linear networks
blocks.zh: 3.1 衍生线性网络中的光谱抗碰撞机制

blocks.en:
Linear-network setting. Consider a supervised dataset 𝒟 = { ( 𝐱 n , 𝐲 n ) } n = 1 P \mathcal{D}=\left\{(\mathbf{x}_{n},\mathbf{y}_{n})\right\}_{n=1}^{P} , 𝐱 n ∈ ℝ N i \mathbf{x}_{n}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{i}} , 𝐲 n ∈ ℝ N o . \mathbf{y}_{n}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{o}}. We model the input–output mapping using a two-layer linear network, 𝐲 ^ n = 𝐖 2 ​ 𝐖 1 ​ 𝐱 n , \widehat{\mathbf{y}}_{n}=\mathbf{W}_{2}\mathbf{W}_{1}\mathbf{x}_{n}, where 𝐖 1 ∈ ℝ N h × N i \mathbf{W}_{1}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{h}\times N_{i}} and 𝐖 2 ∈ ℝ N o × N h \mathbf{W}_{2}\in\mathbb{R}^{N_{o}\times N_{h}} denote the encoder and decoder weight
matrices, respectively. The network is trained on the mean-squared-error loss ℒ task ​ ( 𝐖 1 , 𝐖 2 ) = 1 2 ​ ⟨ ‖ 𝐖 2 ​ 𝐖 1 ​ 𝐱 − 𝐲 ‖ 2 2 ⟩ , \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{task}}(\mathbf{W}_{1},\mathbf{W}_{2})=\frac{1}{2}\left\langle\left\|\mathbf{W}_{2}\mathbf{W}_{1}\mathbf{x}-\mathbf{y}\right\|_{2}^{2}\right\rangle, where ⟨ ⋅ ⟩ \langle\cdot\rangle denotes the empirical average over the training
set. Although the task loss depends only on the end-to-end mapping 𝐌 = 𝐖 2 ​ 𝐖 1 \mathbf{M}=\mathbf{W}_{2}\mathbf{W}_{1} , its factorization across the two layers affects the parameter
and representation dynamics. We characterize this factorization through
the layer-imbalance matrix 𝚫 = 𝐖 2 ⊤ ​ 𝐖 2 − 𝐖 1 ​ 𝐖 1 ⊤ . \mathbf{\Delta}=\mathbf{W}_{2}^{\top}\mathbf{W}_{2}-\mathbf{W}_{1}\mathbf{W}_{1}^{\top}. A network is said to be λ \lambda -balanced when 𝚫 = λ ​ 𝐈 N h . \mathbf{\Delta}=\lambda\mathbf{I}_{N_{h}}. Previous work has shown that λ \lambda -balanced initializations provide an analytically tractable framework for characterizing the transition between rich and lazy learning dynamics ( Dominé et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2025 ) . Under unregularized gradient flow, 𝚫 \mathbf{\Delta} is conserved, so the layer balance remains fixed at its initial value. Prior studies have also linked these learning regimes to the rank of the representations Saxe et al. (2014) ; Atanasov et al. (2022) . Motivated by this connection, we investigate whether a suitable layer balance can prevent representation collapse. We show that an appropriately chosen negative balance provides such a guarantee, and use this result to derive a regularizer that dynamically promotes the same anti-collapse property during training.

Balancedness anti-collapse property. A negative layer balance provides an explicit anti-collapse guarantee.

the hidden representations under the assumption that, for some κ x > 0 \kappa_{x}>0 , the input

In fact, the centered covariance of the hidden representations 𝐡 n = 𝐖 1 ​ 𝐱 n \mathbf{h}_{n}=\mathbf{W}_{1}\mathbf{x}_{n} satisfies 𝐂 h = 𝐖 1 ​ 𝚺 x ​ 𝐖 1 ⊤ ⪰ − κ x ​ λ bal ​ 𝐈 N h . \mathbf{C}_{h}=\mathbf{W}_{1}\bm{\Sigma}_{x}\mathbf{W}_{1}^{\top}\succeq-\kappa_{x}\lambda_{\mathrm{bal}}\mathbf{I}_{N_{h}}. Therefore, negative layer balance prevents representation collapse, see Lemma A.4 in Appendix A.1.3 for a formal statement and proof.

Although a negative balanced initialization prevents collapse, extending the same initialization strategy to deep nonlinear networks is non-trivial.
We therefore seek a regularized training objective that dynamically selects a negative layer balance, independently of its initial value. Motivated by this objective, we derive a regularizer that follows from a constrained optimization problem.

The regularizer combines symmetric L 2 L_{2} weight decay with a log-determinant term acting specifically on the encoder Gram matrix.
This placement is motivated by the non-collapse condition:
a negative layer balance bounds the encoder Gram matrix away from being singular and under the input-covariance assumption, guarantees non-collapse of the hidden representations. The log-determinant term
penalizes vanishing encoder singular values, while weight decay controls the overall weight scale.

blocks.zh: 3.3 JE-SSL的光谱防螺旋

As shown in Fig. 1 , standard JE-SSL objectives
can leave backbone representations dimensionally collapsed.
To address this, we apply the spectral anti-collapse regularizer (SACReg),
introduced in Section 3.2 ,
to joint-embedding self-supervised learning (JE-SSL), targeting
variation between images to prevent representation collapse. Standard JE-SSL objectives enforce invariance and prevent collapse in the projected space 𝐳 \mathbf{z} . blocks.en:
The mean term centers the representation, the trace controls its overall scale, and the negative log-determinant penalizes vanishing covariance directions.
The projected-space term provides anti-collapse where the SSL objective is optimized, while the backbone term directly protects the representation retained for downstream transfer. When applying our regularizer to an existing SSL method that already contains its own projected-space anti-collapse mechanism, we leave its original objective unchanged and add only the backbone term, β h ​ SACReg ⁡ ( 𝐇 ¯ ) \beta_{h}\operatorname{SACReg}(\bar{\mathbf{H}}) .
In practice, when the feature dimension exceeds the number of image centers in a minibatch, we evaluate the regularizer over orthogonal lower-dimensional slices of the representation, details are given in Appendix B .

平均术语以代表为中心,微量控制其总体规模,负日志决定者惩罚消失的共变方向。
预测空间术语在SSL目标优化的地方提供防碰撞,而主干术语则直接保护保留用于下游转移的表示. 当将常规器应用到已经包含自身预测空间防碰撞机制的现有SSL方法时,我们保留其原始目标不变,只添加主干词β h SACReg ⁡ (H')\beta_{h}\operatorname{SACReg}(\bar\mathbf{H}}).

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate whether SACReg improves the performance and transferability of representations. We first report the performance of the standalone λ \lambda -JEPA objective on image and video benchmarks, then use controlled ImageNet-100 ( Tian et al., 2020a ) experiments to isolate the effect of backbone regularization across diverse SSL objectives and analyze how it changes representation geometry.
blocks.zh: 我们评价SACReg是否提高了陈述的性能和可转移性。 我们首先报告关于图像和视频基准的独立QQX\lambda-JEPA目标的表现,然后使用受控的ImageNet-100(Tian等人,2020年a)实验来隔离不同SSL目标的骨干规范化效果,并分析它如何改变代表几何.

blocks.en: 4.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 设置

blocks.en: We consider two experimental settings. Our main evaluation covers large-scale image and video SSL. For images, we train ViT-S and ViT-B ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2021 ) on ImageNet-1k ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) for 100 and 400 epochs from scratch. For video, we follow LeVJEPA ( Kuhn et al., 2026 ) and train ViT-S and ViT-B from scratch on a class-balanced 20% subset of Kinetics-710 ( Li et al., 2023 ) , for up to 1,085 epochs. Our controlled experiments use ViT-S on ImageNet-100 ( Tian et al., 2020a ) to study the effect of SACReg across different SSL objectives.
blocks.zh: 我们考虑两种实验环境。 我们的主要评价涵盖大规模图像和视频SSL. 对于图像,我们从零开始在ImageNet-1k(Russakovsky等人,2015年)上为100和400个纪元进行ViT-S和ViT-B(Dosovitskiy等人,2021年)的培训. 对于视频,我们跟随LeVJEPA(Kuhn等人,2026年),从零开始将ViT-S和ViT-B从一个班级平衡20%的子集Kinetics-710(Li等人,2023年)上训练,最多可达1085个纪元. 我们的控制实验利用VIT-S在ImageNet-100(Tian等人,2020年a)上研究SACReg对不同的SSL目标的影响.

blocks.en: Due to compute limitations, we do not retune hyperparameters for the 400-epoch ImageNet-1k or 1,085-epoch video runs; we use these primarily to study scaling with extended training. For evaluation, we follow standard frozen feature protocols: the Lightly ( Susmelj et al., 2020 ) linear probe benchmark on ImageNet-1k, the VISReg ( Wu et al., 2026 ) pipeline for transfer and the LeVJEPA pipeline for video. Details are given in Appendix C . Whenever public checkpoints trained under a common codebase are available (OpenKnowledge AI 2 2 2 https://huggingface.co/collections/OK-AI/imagenet-1k-self-supervised-vit-baselines ), we evaluate them under the same pipeline, otherwise we report published numbers. We set the loss weights using the gradient-based calibration procedure described in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 由于计算限制,我们不重新调整400世纪的ImageNet-1k或1,085世纪的视频运行的超参数;我们主要利用这些来研究扩展训练的缩放。 为了评价,我们遵循标准冻结特征协议:Lightly(Susmelj等人,2020年)ImageNet-1k线性探测基准,VISReg(Wu等人,2026年)传输管道和LeVJEPA视频管道. 详情见附录C。 每当公共检查站在共同密码库下接受训练时(OpenKnowledge AI 2 2 https://huggingface.co/collections/OK-AI/imagenet-1k-self-supervised-vit-baselines),我们都会在同一管道下评价这些检查站,否则我们报告公布的数字。 我们使用附录C.3所述梯度校准程序设定损失权重。

blocks.en: 4.2 Performance on image self-supervised learning
blocks.zh: 4.2 图像自我监督学习的表现

blocks.en: Table 1 reports our main 100-epoch results on ImageNet-1k linear probing and average transfer across eight classification datasets. We compare most directly with LeJEPA ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) and VISReg ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , the related explicitly regularized JE-SSL methods. We include DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) and iBOT ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) as established SSL baselines for broader comparison which, until now, have significantly outperformed JEPA-based models. At 100 epochs, where training length is matched, λ \lambda -JEPA substantially improves over prior explicitly regularized methods on both ImageNet-1k linear probing and transfer. The gains are particularly strong on transfer, improving over LeJEPA by 8.9 points with ViT-S and over VISReg by 4.5 points with ViT-B. λ \lambda -JEPA is also competitive with DINO and iBOT: its ImageNet-1k performance approaches these methods, while both model sizes achieve the highest average transfer among the 100-epoch results.
blocks.zh: 表1汇报了我们在ImageNet-1k线性探测和平均在8个分类数据集中传输的100世纪的主要结果。 我们最直接地与LeJEPA(Balestriero and LeCun, 2025年)和VISReg(Wu等人, 2026年)进行比较, 我们把DINO(Caron等人,2021年)和iBOT(Zhou等人,2022年)作为既定的SSL基线,以便进行更广泛的比较,迄今为止,这些基准的效绩大大超过基于JEPA的模型。 在100个世纪,培训时间长度相匹配,\\ lambda-JEPA在ImageNet-1k线性探测和传输上大大改进了先前明确规范的方法。 转让收益尤其强劲,与LeJEPA相比,与VIT-S相比提高了8.9个百分点,与VIT-B相比提高了4.5个百分点。 QQ\lambda-JEPA也与DINO和iBOT具有竞争力:它的ImageNet-1k性能采用了这些方法,而两种模型大小在100世纪成果中实现了最高的平均转让。

blocks.en: Table 1 reports results with extended pretraining: we use the same recipe and hyperparameters as the 100-epoch experiments, without any additional tuning for the longer runs. Extending λ \lambda -JEPA to 400 epochs improves both ImageNet-1k linear probing and transfer performance. Since the available checkpoints use different training lengths, we include them as longer training comparisons rather than strictly matched baselines. With ViT-B, λ \lambda -JEPA reaches 82.0 average transfer, outperforming the 400-epoch VISReg result by 2.9 points and coming within 1.2 points of DINO and iBOT. With ViT-S, it reaches 79.3 average transfer, essentially matching the 300-epoch DINO and iBOT results.
blocks.zh: 表1报告的结果是延长了预训:我们使用与100世纪实验相同的食谱和超参数,没有为更长的运行时间作任何额外的调整。 将 QQ\lambda - JEPA 扩展到 400 个纪元可以改善ImageNet-1k线性探测和传输性能. 由于现有的检查站使用不同的培训时间长度,我们把它们列为较长的培训比较,而不是严格匹配的基线。 随着VIT-B,\\lambda-JEPA的平均转会率达到82.0,比400世纪的VISReg成绩高2.9分,并进入DINO和iBOT的1.2分之内. 随着ViT-S,它达到了79.3的平均转录,基本上匹配了300个时代的DINO和iBOT结果.

blocks.en: Takeaway. λ \lambda -JEPA substantially improves over prior explicitly regularized JE-SSL methods on both ImageNet-1k classification and transfer. To the best of our knowledge, it is the first JEPA-based method to approach DINO and iBOT on both evaluations, while achieving the highest average transfer performance at 100 epochs.
blocks.zh: 外卖 \\lambda - JEPA在ImageNet-1k分类和传输上大大改进了先前明确规范的JE-SSL方法。 据我们所知,这是第一个基于JEPA的方法,在两次评价中都接近DINO和iBOT,同时达到100个纪元的平均转移业绩最高.

blocks.zh: 4.3 视频自我监督学习的表现

blocks.en: We apply the same objective to video by replacing the loss inside the LeVJEPA ( Kuhn et al., 2026 ) training pipeline while keeping the model, optimizer and data pipeline unchanged. We train these models from scratch and freeze the encoders after pretraining. The frozen encoders are evaluated on three benchmarks with different characteristics: ImageNet-1k for recognition from a single image, Something-Something-v2 (SSv2) ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) for temporal reasoning and Kinetics-400 ( Kay et al., 2017 ) for action recognition.
blocks.zh: 我们采用同样的目标,在LeVJEPA(Kuhn等人,2026年)培训管道内更换损失,同时保持模型、优化器和数据管道不变。 我们从头开始训练这些模型 并在预训后冻结编码器 冻结编码器按三个具有不同特点的基准进行评估: ImageNet-1k用于单个图像的识别,Something-Something-v2(SSv2)(Goyal等人,2017年)用于时间推理,Kinetics-400(Kay等人,2017年)用于动作识别.

blocks.en: Table 2 compares λ \lambda -JEPA with LeVJEPA, V-JEPA 2 ( Assran et al., 2025 ) and VideoMAEv2 ( Wang et al., 2023 ) . At 240 epochs, λ \lambda -JEPA improves over LeVJEPA and V-JEPA 2 on ImageNet-1k for both ViT-S and ViT-B. The largest gains are on SSv2: our ViT-B improves over LeVJEPA by 13.5 points at 240 epochs and by 7.9 points at 1,085 epochs. For ImageNet-1k and SSv2, LeVJEPA evaluates frozen features with an attentive probe followed by a linear classifier, whereas on K400 it reports a linear probe on mean-pooled features. In our setting, SACReg is applied to the CLS representation, so we report a CLS probe in Table 2 , evaluating the representation directly regularized during pretraining. It reaches 45.7 at 1,085 epochs compared with 44.6 for LeVJEPA’s probe over the mean-pooled features. For completeness, we also evaluate the same frozen encoder using mean-pooled features and an attentive probe, obtaining 43.4 and 62.0, respectively. The lower mean-pooled result is consistent with these features not being directly regularized in our setup.

blocks.en: Takeaway. λ \lambda -JEPA extends effectively to video SSL, with its clearest gains on temporal evaluations, showing that the benefits of backbone spectral regularization transfer beyond image pretraining.

blocks.en: 4.4 Controlled experiments on ImageNet-100
blocks.zh: 4.4 在ImageNet-100上的受控制实验

blocks.en: We next use controlled ImageNet-100 experiments to better understand the effects of SACReg across SSL objectives. Our analysis focuses on two questions: how SACReg changes representation geometry and downstream performance, and what variation is recovered in the additional representation directions. To this end, we apply SACReg to the backbone representations of six existing augmentation-based SSL methods on ImageNet-100 ( Tian et al., 2020a ) : LeJEPA ( Balestriero and LeCun, 2025 ) , VICReg ( Bardes et al., 2022 ) , VISReg ( Wu et al., 2026 ) , SimCLR ( Chen et al., 2020 ) , DINO ( Caron et al., 2021 ) , and BYOL ( Grill et al., 2020 ) . For each method, we keep its original objective and training recipe unchanged and add only β h ​ SACReg \beta_{\mathrm{h}}\operatorname{SACReg} to the backbone representation. The regularizer weight is set using the gradient based calibration procedure (see Appendix C.3 for details) and is not tuned individually to the methods except DINO. For DINO we tune the weight separately due to its sensitivity to the gradient ratios.
blocks.zh: 我们接下来将使用受控的ImageNet-100实验来更好地理解SACReg跨SSL目标的影响. 我们的分析侧重于两个问题:SACReg如何改变代表几何和下游的性能,以及在其他代表方向中恢复哪些变化。 为此,我们在ImageNet-100(Tian等人,2020年a)上将SACReg应用于基于扩增的现有6种SSL方法的骨干表示:LeJEPA(Balestriero and LeCun,2025年),VICReg(Bardes等人,2022年),VISReg(Wu等人,2026年),SimCLR (Chen等人,2020年),DINO(Caron等人,2021年),和BYOL(Grill等人,2020年). 对于每一种方法,我们保持原有的目标和训练食谱不变,只在骨干代表中加入β h SACReg\β mathrm{h}}\operatorname{SACReg}. 调节器权重采用梯度校准程序设定(详见附录C.3),除DINO外,不单独调整为方法. 对DINO来说,由于对梯度比的敏感性,我们把重量分开调节。

blocks.en: Figure 2 (top) shows that applying SACReg to the backbones produces a consistent change in the representations across objectives. At the backbone, RankMe increases substantially for every method, while the cosine geometry becomes less concentrated. Negative-pair cosine similarities approach zero while positive-pairs generally decrease as well. In contrast, corresponding statistics in the projection/loss space change much less. This suggests that SACReg primarily reshapes the backbone representation without substantially impeding the learning after the projection. The same intervention also improves downstream performance. kNN accuracy improves across all methods convincingly, while linear probe accuracy also improves, with smaller gains for VICReg. Notably, the gains therefore do not come from making positive pairs more invariant.
blocks.zh: 图2(上)显示,将SACReg应用到骨干上,使各目标之间的表述方式发生了一致的变化。 在骨干上,RankMe对每种方法都大幅提升,而余弦几何则变得不那么集中. 负-帕氏同位素相似性接近于零,而正帕氏同位素也普遍下降. 相比之下,预测/损失空间中的相应统计数据变化要小得多。 这表明,SACREG主要重塑骨干代表,而不会在预测后严重阻碍学习。 同样的干预措施也改善了下游的业绩。 kNN精度在所有方法中都有令人信服的提高,而线性探测精度也有提高,对VICReg的增益较小. 值得注意的是,这些收益并非来自使正对更无变化。

blocks.en: Figure 2 (bottom) shows that, averaged across classes, all six SSL methods have greater class-center separability and greater view sensitivity under SACReg. Therefore, SACReg’s downstream gains are not obtained by suppressing augmentation-dependent variation. Specifically, the more consistent effect is an improvement in how image centers are organized along downstream-relevant directions. For λ \lambda -JEPA, class-center separability improves for 96 of 100 classes, whereas view sensitivity moves in both directions. SACReg therefore consistently improves class-center separation without uniformly moving the representation toward either invariance or augmentation sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 图2(下方)显示,按不同类别平均计算,所有六种SSL方法在SACReg下具有更高的班级中心分离性和更高的视野敏感性. 因此,SACREG的下游收益不是通过抑制依赖增强的变异获得的。 具体来说,更一致的效果是改进了沿下游相关方向组织图像中心的方式。 对\\lambda-JEPA来说,100个班中有96个班的班级中心可分离性得到改善,而视图敏感性则朝两个方向移动。 因此,SACREG一贯改善班级中心分离,而不统一将代表性转向偏差或增强敏感性。

blocks.en: Takeaway. Across diverse SSL objectives, SACReg consistently increases representation rank and improves downstream performance. The augmentation thickness analysis shows that these gains are not explained by increased augmentation invariance. SACReg improves class-center separation while preserving augmentation variation.
blocks.zh: 外卖 在各种SSL目标中,SACREG不断提高代表级别,改善下游的业绩。 增益厚度分析表明,这些增益不是由增加增益的偏移来解释的。 SACReg改进了班级中心分离,同时保留了增强变异.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we targeted the asymmetry between anti-collapse regularization in joint embedding self-supervised models and the representation used for downstream tasks. First, we showed that preventing collapse in the projected representation does not guarantee a high rank backbone representation. This matters because a low rank backbone reduces the representational capacity, which can harm downstream performance. Our solution is directly motivated by a linear analysis of negative layer balance, which is known as λ \lambda balance in the feature learning literature. From this, we introduced SACReg, which directly regularizes the representation covariance, and used it to build λ \lambda -JEPA. In controlled experiments, SACReg consistently increases backbone rank and improves downstream performance while preserving augmentation-dependent variation. At scale, λ \lambda -JEPA narrows the gap between explicitly regularized JEPA methods and DINO, while improving frozen transfer across image and video SSL benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 在这份文件中,我们针对的是联合嵌入自我监督模型中的反碰撞正规化与下游任务使用的代表性之间的不对称。 首先,我们表明,防止预计代表性的崩溃并不能保证骨干地位高。 这很重要,因为低级骨干会降低代表能力,这可能会损害下游的业绩. 我们的解决方案直接是出于对负层平衡的线性分析,这在特征学习文献中被称为QQ\lambda平衡. 我们从这开始引入了SACReg, 直接规范了代表共性, 在受控实验中,SACReg不断提高骨干排名,提高下游性能,同时保留依赖增强的变异. 在规模上,\\lambda - JEPA缩小了明确规范的JEPA方法与DINO之间的差距,同时改善了跨图像和视频SSL基准的冻结传输.

blocks.en: SACReg regularizes CLS tokens and uses global views. Extending it to patch-level features and local crops is non-trivial: local views introduce substantially larger augmentation-induced variation, making the per-image view centers noisier and the covariance across centers harder to regularize reliably. In our experiments, this led to unstable training. Understanding how different augmentations shape this variation and which augmentation-sensitive directions are useful for downstream tasks remains an open direction for future work. Developing a formulation that more robustly regularizes spatially local representations while separating augmentation variation from between-image variation could further improve performance on dense prediction tasks. Additionally, JEPA-style models have already been connected with world modeling and identifiabilty theory for learning causal representations ( Klindt et al., 2026 ) . This is conceptually natural, as JEPA models optimize the same principles of causal representations: invariance to relevant transformations and anti-collapse ( Yao et al., 2025 ) . However, methods in causal representation learning leverage mostly negative samples (and sometimes reconstruction) to implement the anti-collapse properties. We encourage future work to explore the role of our regularizer in the identifiability of world models.
blocks.zh: SACReg将CLS符号规范化,并使用全局视图. 将其扩展至补丁级特征和当地作物是非三角性的:地方观点引入了大得多的增殖引起的变异,使得每个图像的收视中心噪声和不同中心的共变更难可靠地规范化. 在我们的实验中,这导致了不稳定的训练. 了解不同的增强因素如何决定这种变化,以及哪些增强敏感方向对下游任务有用,仍然是今后工作的开放方向。 开发一种使空间局部表示更加规范化,同时将放大变异与图像间变异区分开来,可以进一步提高密集预测任务的业绩。 此外,JEPA风格的模型已经与学习因果关系的世界模型和识别理论联系起来(Klindt等人,2026年)。 这在概念上是自然的,因为JEPA模型优化了因果表示的相同原则:与相关转变和反碰撞不一致(姚等人,2025年)。 然而,因果表示学习方法主要利用负面样本(有时是重建)来实施防碰撞特性。 我们鼓励今后努力探索我们的常态化者在世界模式可识别性中的作用。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work studies methods for self-supervised representation learning using established image and video datasets and does not involve human-subject experiments or the collection of new personal or sensitive data. We are not aware of specific ethical concerns introduced by the proposed method beyond those generally associated with large-scale representation learning and computer vision models. The work is intended as a general-purpose methodological contribution and we encourage appropriate consideration of dataset provenance, bias and privacy risks when deploying learned representations.
blocks.zh: 这种工作研究方法用于利用既定的图像和视频数据集进行自我监督的表示学习,不涉及人主体实验或收集新的个人或敏感数据. 我们没有意识到拟议方法所提出的具体道德关切,这些关切超出了通常与大规模代表性学习和计算机视觉模型有关的关切。 这项工作旨在作为通用方法的贡献,我们鼓励在运用学到的表述时适当考虑数据集的来源、偏见和隐私风险。

blocks.en: Reproducibility statement
blocks.zh: 可复制说明

blocks.en: We provide detailed information required to reproduce our theoretical and empirical results throughout the paper and appendices. The assumptions, statements and proofs supporting the theoretical results are provided in Appendix A . For the empirical results, implementation details for SACReg are given in Appendix B , Appendix C includes information about datasets, architectures, training procedures, loss-weight calibration, evaluation pipelines and baselines used in our experiments. Additional analyses and their definitions are provided in Appendices D and E . We reuse public baseline implementations and checkpoints whenever available, and explicitly document differences in training and evaluation protocols when exact matching is not possible. In particular, for video SSL, some baselines use different frozen-feature evaluation protocols (e.g., CLS, mean-pooled, or attentive probes); we report the corresponding protocols and evaluate our representations under multiple probe choices to facilitate comparison. Furthermore, we provide supplementary material containing the code used to run every experiment reported in the paper. These materials are intended to enable reproduction of both the proposed method and the empirical evaluations.
blocks.zh: 我们提供必要的详细资料,以便在整个文件和附录中转载我们的理论和经验成果。 支持理论结果的假设、声明和证明载于附录A。 关于实证结果,附录B提供了SACReg的执行细节,附录C包括有关数据集、架构、培训程序、减重校准、评价管道和我们实验中使用的基线的信息。 附录D和E提供了其他分析和定义。 我们尽可能重新使用公共基线执行和检查站,并在无法准确匹配时明确记录培训和评价协议的差异。 特别是,对于视频SSL,一些基线使用不同的冷冻度评价协议(如CLS,平均集合,或细心探测器);我们报告相应的协议,并评价我们在多个探测选择下的表示,以便于比较. 此外,我们提供了补充材料,其中载有用于进行文件中所报告的每一项试验的代码。 这些材料旨在复制拟议方法和实证评价。

A.1.7 Rich and lazy regime
blocks.zh: A.1.7 富裕和懒惰的制度

blocks.en: The ratio − γ / λ reg -\gamma/\lambda_{\mathrm{reg}} determines the selected layer balance and thereby influences the learning regime. For a fixed end-to-end mapping, it governs how each singular mode is distributed between the encoder and decoder. Zero balance ( λ bal = 0 \lambda_{\mathrm{bal}}=0 ) corresponds to equal layer singular values, whereas nonzero balance introduces an asymmetry. The effect of this balance on learning depends on the architecture, initialization scale, and sign of λ bal \lambda_{\mathrm{bal}} ( Dominé et al., 2025 ) . In the linear setting considered here, sufficiently strong negative imbalance can favor lazy dynamics while preserving the anti-collapse guarantee. By contrast, zero-balanced initialization can support rich dynamics at sufficiently small initialization scales. The relationship between imbalance and learning regime is more complex in nonlinear networks, where full matrix imbalance is not conserved and does not necessarily induce lazy learning. Appropriate asymmetric parameter scalings can instead accelerate the onset of rich feature-learning dynamics while preserving the non-collapse property ( Anguita et al., 2026 ; Kumar et al., 2024 ; Kunin et al., 2024 ) . We discuss this distinction further in Appendix A.2.3 .
blocks.zh: 比例 – γ / λ reg -\gamma/\lambda _{\ mathrm{reg}确定选定的层平衡,从而影响学习制度。 对于固定的端对端映射,它支配着每个单数模式如何在编码器和解码器之间分配. 零平衡(QQ bal = 0\lambda_{\ mathrm{bal}}=0)对应于等层单数,而非零平衡引入不对称. 这种平衡对学习的影响取决于架构,初始化尺度,以及QQ bal\lambda\ mathrm{bal}的标志. (Dominé等人,2025年). 在本文中考虑的线性背景中,足够强烈的负面不平衡可以有利于懒惰的动态,同时保留防碰撞的保证. 相比之下,零平衡初始化可以在足够小的初始化规模上支持丰富的动态. 在非线性网络中,不平衡与学习制度的关系更为复杂,在非线性网络中,完全矩阵失衡没有得到保存,并不一定诱导懒惰学习. 适当的非对称参数缩放可以加速丰富的特征学习动态的开始,同时保留非碰撞属性(Angita等人,2026年;Kumar等人,2024年;Kuin等人,2024年)。 我们在附录A.2.3中进一步讨论了这一区别。

blocks.en: To understand the inductive bias of the regularizer, we consider its minimizer in isolation. Feature learning. Using the two-layer ReLU network setup of Kunin et al. (2024) ,
we investigate how the rank effects and the learning regime
of the initial imbalance λ \lambda relate to those of the
SAC regularizer. Linear theory suggests that a negative
relative scale should favor the same anti-collapse behavior
promoted by SAC regularization.

blocks.en:
• Rank. There is no exact correspondence between the initial imbalance λ \lambda and the regularization weight w reg w_{\mathrm{reg}} .
The regularizer appears to exert a substantially stronger
effect on rank (see Fig. 4 ).
Nevertheless, both negative λ \lambda (relative to λ ≥ 0 \lambda\geq 0 ) and positive w reg w_{\mathrm{reg}} favor higher rank in the Rich regime, supporting a qualitative
connection between initial imbalance and anti-collapse
regularization (see Fig. 4 ).
Interestingly, the rank effect of negative λ \lambda emerges
during training rather than reflecting a decaying initial
offset. All negative- λ \lambda runs with w reg = 0 w_{\mathrm{reg}}=0 begin at approximately the same effective rank fraction, 𝚎𝚏𝚏𝚛𝚊𝚗𝚔 ​ _ ​ 𝚏𝚛𝚊𝚌 = 0.467 \mathtt{effrank\_frac}=0.467 , consistent with their shared
initialization (see Table 3 ).
This quantity then increases monotonically throughout training,
indicating that the higher final rank develops through the
training dynamics. • Learning regime. We characterize the learning regime by measuring the departure
of the neural tangent kernel (NTK) from its value at
initialization, quantified by kernel distance.
Increasing w reg w_{\mathrm{reg}} leads to an increase in kernel
distance across the initialization scales considered, indicating
that stronger regularization promotes greater kernel evolution
(see Fig. 4 ).
It also extends the range of initialization scales over which
feature learning occurs, although kernel evolution remains
limited at sufficiently large scales
(see Fig. 4 ).
At small initialization scales, varying λ \lambda alone yields
kernel distance values between 0.16 0.16 and 0.58 0.58 , comparable
to the range obtained by varying w reg w_{\mathrm{reg}} .
At large initialization scales, however, both parameters have
little effect on kernel evolution.
These results suggest that λ \lambda primarily modulates
the degree of feature learning within an already rich regime,
whereas w reg w_{\mathrm{reg}} can also promote departures from
otherwise lazy dynamics.
Altogether, we find that regularization promotes feature
learning across a range of initialization scales, with stronger
regularization associated with more pronounced feature learning
(see Fig. 4 in Appendix A.2.3 ).
A similar trend emerges in the self-supervised setting.
We show that both the backbone representations and the empirical
NTK move substantially from initialization during training,
consistent with rich learning dynamics
(Fig. 5 and Appendix A.2.4 ).

blocks.en:
Figure 5 shows substantial drift in both representations and the empirical NTK. Feature drift increases with depth, reaching its largest value at the final transformer block. The NTK moves away from its initialization during
the first 25 epochs and then changes only slightly between subsequent checkpoints. Together, these measurements are consistent with rich feature learning.

最初的25个纪元,然后在之后的检查站之间只稍有变化。 这些测量结果加在一起与丰富的特征学习是一致的.

Thus, slicing does not change the preferred representation: averaging
over random subspaces still uniquely favors zero mean and isotropic
unit covariance. The mean and total variance are preserved exactly in
expectation, while the log-determinant observes only the spectrum inside
the sampled subspace. Wider slices therefore capture progressively more
of the full spectral penalty, recovering the original regularizer when d ′ = d d^{\prime}=d . In practice, we choose d ′ < d d^{\prime}<d so that the projected covariance
can be estimated from substantially more centers than dimensions.

blocks.en:
Reliable covariance estimation requires more centers than the slice dimension.
For each regularized space, we therefore maintain a FIFO buffer containing detached view centers from the previous q q steps and concatenate them with the current batch before computing the regularizer.
This gives B eff = ( q + 1 ) ​ B , B_{\mathrm{eff}}=(q+1)B, where only the current B B centers carry gradients.
Under data parallelism, the buffer contains centers from the full global batch.

因此,对于每个正态化空间,我们维持一个FIFO缓冲器,其中包含从之前的q q步骤中分离的视图中心,并在计算正态器之前将其与当前批量结合.
这使得Beff = (q + 1) B,B_{\ mathrm{eff}}=(q+1)B,其中只有目前的B B中心带有梯度.
在数据平行性下,缓冲器包含来自全全球批量的中心.

blocks.en: Appendix C Experimental Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 细节

blocks.en: C.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: C.1 数据集

blocks.en: ImageNet-1k ( Russakovsky et al., 2015 ) is the standard split with 1.28M training and 50k validation images. ImageNet-100 is the 100-class subset introduced by CMC ( Tian et al., 2020a ) , with 126,689 training and 5,000 validation images. For video we follow LeVJEPA ( Kuhn et al., 2026 ) : we take the union of the Kinetics-400, -600 and -700 ( Li et al., 2023 ) training sets, remove duplicates and every clip that appears in a validation set, and keep 20% of the clips of each class (120,100 clips after decoding). LeVJEPA does not release its subset, so ours is a different draw of the same size. Transfer ( Ericsson et al., 2021 ) uses DTD ( Cimpoi et al., 2014 ) , Aircraft ( Maji et al., 2013 ) , Cars ( Krause et al., 2013 ) , CIFAR10, CIFAR100 ( Krizhevsky, 2009 ) , Flowers ( Nilsback and Zisserman, 2008 ) , Food ( Bossard et al., 2014 ) and Pets ( Parkhi et al., 2012 ) with the splits of the VISReg protocol ( Wu et al., 2026 ) ; video encoders are evaluated on ImageNet-1k, Something-Something-v2 ( Goyal et al., 2017 ) and Kinetics-400 ( Kay et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh: ImageNet-1k(Russakovsky et al., 2015)是标准拆分,包含1.28M训练和50k验证图像. ImageNet-100是CMC推出的100级子集(Tian等人,2020a),拥有126,689个培训和5000个验证图像. 关于录像,我们跟随LeVJEPA(Kuhn等人,2026年):我们采用Kinetics-400,-600和-700(Li等人,2023年)的训练集,去除重复和每个在验证集中出现的片段,保留每班20%的片段(解码后120,100片段). LeVJEPA不会释放它的子集,所以我们的是一个大小相同的不同的图. 转让(Ericsson等人,2021年)使用DTD(Cimpoi等人,2014年),飞机 (Maji等人,2013年),汽车 (Krause等人,2013年),CIFAR10,CIFAR100(Krizhevsky,2009年),花朵 (Nilsback和Zisserman,2008年),Food(Bossard等人,2014年)和Pets(Parkhi等人,2012年)与VISReg协议的分割(Wu等人,2026年);视频编码器在ImageNet-1k,Somethinging-v2(Goyal等人,2017年)和Kinetics-400(Kay等人,2017年)上评价.

blocks.en: C.2 Models and training
blocks.zh: C.2 模式和培训

blocks.en: We train ViT-S/16 and ViT-B/16 at 224 2 224^{2} with a two-layer projector (hidden width 2048, output 256, BatchNorm), batch size 128 split over two GPUs, for 100 and 400 epochs. Each image gives V = 6 V=6 global views from the LeJEPA augmentation family: random resized crops covering 30–100% of the image, horizontal flips, color jitter, random grayscale, Gaussian blur, and solarization on one of the views. We do not use local crops. The slices and buffers are as described in Appendix B . Optimization uses AdamW with learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 0.05 0.05 , 10 warm-up epochs followed by a cosine schedule, gradient clipping at 1.0, and bf16 precision. The loss weights are ( 31.07 , 225.50 , 1.671 ) (31.07,\,225.50,\,1.671) for ViT-S and ( 22.81 , 222.26 , 4.054 ) (22.81,\,222.26,\,4.054) for ViT-B, for the invariance term, β z \beta_{z} and β h \beta_{h} respectively; they are set as described below and shared by the 100- and 400-epoch runs.
blocks.zh: 我们用双层投影仪(隐藏宽度2048,输出256,BatchNorm),在224 224 224~X2}的ViT-S/16和ViT-B/16次列车,批量尺寸128,与两个GPU分开,为100和400个纪元. 每个图像都给出了来自LeJEPA增殖家族的V=6 V=6全球视角:随机调整作物大小,覆盖图像的30-100%,水平翻转,色彩焦躁,随机灰度,高斯模糊度,以及其中一个视图的太阳化. 我们不使用当地作物。 切片和缓冲部分如附录B所述。 优化使用 AdamW 的学习速率 10 - 3 10 - 3 - 10 - 3 }, 重量衰减 0.05 - 0.05 , 10 热化时段, 之后是余弦表, 梯度剪切 1.0, 和 bf16 精度. 损失重量分别为(31.07,225.50,1.671)Vit-S(31.07,\225.50,\,1.671)和(22.81,222.26,4.054)Vit-B(22.81,\,222.26,\,4.054),分别是变位词β z \beta_{z}和β h\beta_{h};其设定如下所述,由100-和400-oc运行共用.

blocks.en: All controlled experiments use ViT-S/16 at 224 2 224^{2} , are trained for 100 epochs with batch size 128, and are repeated over three independent random seeds. We re-implement LeJEPA, VICReg, SimCLR, DINO, BYOL, and VISReg within a common training codebase while preserving each method’s released loss, projector, and augmentation settings. For each method, we train a baseline and a matched variant with β h ​ SACReg ⁡ ( 𝐇 ¯ ) \beta_{h}\operatorname{SACReg}(\bar{\mathbf{H}}) added; all other settings are kept fixed, so the two variants differ only by the backbone regularization term. We report the mean across the three seeds. The regularizer is applied to the representation provided as input to each method’s projector: the CLS token for SimCLR, BYOL, VICReg, and DINO, and the 512-dimensional embedding immediately preceding the projector for LeJEPA and VISReg. Our own objective uses V = 4 V=4 views and the pairwise invariance term defined in Appendix B , with weights 32.8 32.8 for invariance, 157.8 157.8 for β z \beta_{z} , and 1.894 1.894 for β h \beta_{h} . The corresponding baseline sets β h = 0 \beta_{h}=0 , with all other settings unchanged.

blocks.en: We use LeVJEPA’s training pipeline and released configuration unchanged except for the loss: their video ViT-S/16 and ViT-B/16 (16 frames at stride 2, tubelet size 1, 95% token drop), their projector, and their optimizer (AdamW, learning rate 4 × 10 − 4 4\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 0.04 0.04 , warm-up over 12% of training followed by a constant learning rate, bf16). Our loss takes V = 6 V=6 global 224 2 224^{2} views of the same clip. The batch size is 768 for ViT-S and 512 for ViT-B, the loss weights are those of the image run of the same model size, and we evaluate the exponential-moving-average encoder, as LeVJEPA does.

ViT-S的批量尺寸为768,ViT-B的批量尺寸为512,损失重量是相同模型大小的图像运行,我们评价指数-移动-平均编码器,就像LeVJEPA所做的那样.

blocks.zh: C.3 联合国 设定损失权重

For a term with weight w w , let g g be the norm of the gradient of the unweighted term with respect to the backbone parameters, measured on a fixed batch at a given checkpoint. The product w ​ g w\,g is the pull of the term, and its share of the total pull is w ​ g / ∑ k w k ​ g k w\,g/\sum_{k}w_{k}g_{k} .

blocks.en: C.4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: C.4 评价

blocks.en: We follow the linear-evaluation recipe of the Lightly benchmark (the MAE linear-probe recipe): a BatchNorm layer without affine parameters followed by a linear classifier on the frozen CLS token, trained for 90 epochs with random resized crops and flips, SGD with momentum 0.9 (equivalent to LARS at zero weight decay), learning rate 0.1 × batch / 256 0.1\times\mathrm{batch}/256 with a cosine schedule and 10 warm-up epochs; we report the best validation top-1 over the 90 epochs. The kNN classifier uses k = 200 k=200 neighbors with cosine similarity weighted at temperature 0.07 0.07 , on the CLS features of the training set.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循轻度基准的线性评价配方(MAE线性方案配方):一个没有亲缘参数的批量诺姆层,然后是冻结的CLS符号的线性分类器,为90个作物随机调整大小和翻转的时代训练,SGD为0.9(相当于零重量衰减的LARS),学习速率0.1×批量 / 256 0.1\times\mathrm{batch}/ 256, 并配有余弦表和10个热振历;我们报告90个时期上1级的最佳验证。 kNN分类器在训练集的CLS特性上使用k=200k=200邻,其余弦相似度在0.070.07温下加权.

blocks.en: We use the VISReg transfer protocol: the CLS tokens of the last four blocks are concatenated, a linear classifier is trained for 10 epochs over a grid of 13 learning rates, and the best test accuracy is reported for each dataset; the table reports the average over the eight datasets. Our implementation reproduces the published DINO ViT-B/16 row within 0.4 points on every dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们使用VISReg的传输协议:最后四个块的CLS符号被压缩,一个线性分类器在13个学习速率的网格上为10个纪元训练,每个数据集报告最好的测试精度;表格报告八个数据集的平均精度. 我们的执行在每套数据集的0.4点之内复制了已公布的DINO VIT-B/16行.

blocks.en: The linear probe is a linear classifier on the raw CLS features, trained with AdamW (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 7 10^{-7} ) until validation accuracy stops improving; the kNN classifier uses k = 200 k=200 and temperature 0.1 0.1 . Both are fit on a fixed subset of 500 training images per class and evaluated on the 5,000 validation images.
blocks.zh: 线性探测器是原始CLS特征上的线性分类器,训练有亚当W(学习率10−3 10−3},重量衰减10−7 10−7}),直到验证精度停止提高;kNN分类器使用k=200k=200,温度0.1. 两者都适合固定子集,每班500个训练图像,并在5 000个验证图像上进行评估。

blocks.en: We follow the frozen-encoder protocols of V-JEPA as used by LeVJEPA. ImageNet-1k and Something-Something-v2 use an attentive probe: one cross-attention block with a learnable query over all output tokens followed by a linear classifier, trained for 20 epochs with AdamW (learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , cosine schedule). For ImageNet-1k each image is repeated over the 16 input frames; for Something-Something-v2 a video is sampled as 2 clips of 16 frames with 3 spatial crops. Kinetics-400 uses a linear classifier. LeVJEPA does not release the settings of this linear classifier. So we report the results with L-BFGS (multinomial logistic regression on standardized features, the best of three ridge strengths { 10 − 5 , 10 − 4 , 10 − 3 } \{10^{-5},10^{-4},10^{-3}\} ) using one center crop per clip and the full training and validation sets.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循了LeVJEPA使用的V-JEPA冷冻编码程序。 ImageNet-1k和Something-V2使用一个细心探针:一个交叉探针块,在所有输出符上有一个可学习的查询,然后是一个线性分类器,训练了20个带有AdamW的时代(学习率10 - 3 10 - 3),余弦表. 对于ImageNet-1k,每个图像在16个输入框上重复;对于Something-Something-v2,视频被取样为16个帧的2个片段,并有3个空间作物. Kinetics-400使用线性分类器. LeVJEPA不释放此线性分类器的设置. 因此,我们用L-BFGS(标准化特征的多重后勤回归,三个山脊优势中最好的{10 − 5 、10 − 4 、10 − 3 }} × 10 → 5}、10 → 4}、10 + 3 → ) 报告结果,每片片使用一个中心作物和全套培训和验证装置。

blocks.en: All statistics are computed on frozen features. RankMe ( Garrido et al., 2023 ) is the exponential of the entropy of the normalized singular values reported as a fraction of the feature dimension. Positive and negative-pair cosines are the mean cosine similarity between two views of the same image and between views of two different images.
blocks.zh: 所有统计数字都按冻结特征计算。 军衔 Me(Garrido等人,2023年)是作为特征维度的一小部分报告的常态单数的 en的指数. 阳性与阴性-阴性同位素是同一图像的两个观点和两个不同图像的视角之间的平均同位素相似性.

blocks.en: OK-AI releases LeJEPA, DINO and iBOT trained under one modernized code base at ViT-S and ViT-B for 100 and 300 epochs; we evaluate these checkpoints under the protocols above. Their model card lists 1.45M training images, which is more than the standard ImageNet-1k training split; we did not correct for this. We also trained VISReg ViT-B/16 for 100 epochs with the authors’ code and their released view configuration (four global and six local crops), and evaluated the public MoCo v3, DINO, iBOT and VISReg checkpoints (300–400 epochs) the same way. Transfer numbers marked ‡ are taken from the VISReg paper. Video baselines are taken from the LeVJEPA paper: the 240-epoch numbers from its Fig. 2 and the remaining rows from its equal-compute table.

blocks.en: Appendix D A closer look at LeJEPA
blocks.zh: 附录D 更仔细地审视《正义与平等法》

blocks.en: Our results suggest that anti-collapse should act on the representation retained for downstream tasks. A natural alternative explanation is that the particular regularizer is unimportant: perhaps simply applying an existing anti-collapse objective at the backbone is sufficient. We test this with LeJEPA, one of the explicitly regularized methods in our study.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,应就为下游任务保留的代表性采取行动。 一个自然的替代解释是,特定的正则剂不重要:也许只要在骨干上适用现有的反折叠目标就足够了. 我们用LeJEPA来检验,这是我们研究中明确规范的方法之一。

blocks.en: LeJEPA encourages the projected representation to match an isotropic Gaussian using SIGReg, a sketched Gaussianity test over random one-dimensional projections. However, its retained backbone representation is far from this target (Fig. 1 ). Starting from vanilla LeJEPA, with the original SIGReg and invariance losses after the projector unchanged, we therefore add a second SIGReg term directly to the 512-dimensional encoder output, using the weighting heuristic of Appendix C.3 , and train under the ImageNet-100 setup of Section 4.4 .
blocks.zh: LeJEPA鼓励预测的表示方式与使用SIGREG的异构高斯人相匹配,这是在随机的一维预测之上草图的高斯人性测试. 然而,它保留的主要代表性远远没有达到这一目标(图1)。 从香草LeJEPA开始,在投影仪之后原有的SIGREG和无变化损失不变的情况下,我们因此在512维编码器输出中直接添加了第二个SIGREG术语,使用附录C.3的权重heuristic,并在4.4节的ImageNet-100设置下进行列车.

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that the added SIGReg substantially improves several Gaussianity statistics at the backbone. Negative-pair cosine drops from 0.58 0.58 to 0.01 0.01 , the diagonal Gaussian KL from 0.96 0.96 to 0.07 0.07 , and the Epps–Pulley statistic also decreases. However, the covariance spectrum remains concentrated: RankMe / d /d changes only from 0.07 0.07 to 0.09 0.09 , while the full-covariance KL remains high ( 3.89 → 3.03 3.89\to 3.03 ). At the same time, positive-pair cosine decreases and downstream performance worsens by 1.4 1.4 linear-probe points and 4.3 4.3 kNN points. Thus, the gains from SACReg are not explained simply by moving LeJEPA’s existing anti-collapse constraint to the retained representation. In this comparison, directly controlling the covariance spectrum is important: SIGReg substantially improves its Gaussianity diagnostics but leaves the backbone spectrum concentrated, whereas ℛ SAC \mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{SAC}} acts explicitly on that spectrum through its log-determinant term.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,增加的SIGREG大大改进了几个支柱的高斯统计。 负面余弦从0.58 0.58降至0.01 0.01,对角高斯KL从0.96 0.96降至0.07 0.07,Epps–Pulley统计也有所下降. 然而,共变谱仍然集中: RankMe / d / d 仅从0.07 0.07 变化到0.09 0.09,而全共变谱KL仍然很高(3.89 – 3.03 3.89\to 3.03). 同时,正-帕的余弦下降,下游性能恶化,分别出现1.41.4线性探测点和4.34.3 kNN点. 因此,不能简单地通过将LeJEPA现有的反连带限制移到保留代表权上来解释从SACReg获得的收益。 在这个比较中,直接控制共变频谱很重要:SIGREG大大改进了其高斯度诊断,但使骨干频谱集中,而R SAC \ mathcal{R}_{\ mathrm{SAC}}通过它的日志决定词在该频谱上明确行动.

blocks.en: Appendix E Augmentation thickness: definition and interpretation
blocks.zh: 附录E 增强厚度:定义和解释

blocks.en:
This section gives the formal motivation for the augmentation-thickness quantities used in Section 4.4 . In particular, we show that augmentation thickness has two opposing effects: too little thickness can suppress meaningful augmentation-dependent variation,
whereas too much allows within-image variation to dominate the separation
between images.

太多的画面中的变化 能够支配分离
在图像之间。

blocks.en: The two statements capture complementary failure modes. Equation 47 says that if a target cannot be recovered perfectly from an augmented view, then a representation with very little augmentation thickness cannot nevertheless organize its image centers arbitrarily well for that target. Some augmentation-dependent variation may therefore need to remain in the representation. In the opposite direction, Eq. 49 shows that, once the image-center organization is fixed, additional within-image variation makes prediction from a single view harder. Augmentation thickness therefore describes a trade-off rather than a quantity that should be uniformly minimized.
blocks.zh: 这两个语句抓住了互补的失败模式. 第47条方程式说,如果一个目标不能完全从扩大的视野中恢复,那么一个增加的厚度很小的表述就不能任意地为这个目标组织其图像中心。 因此,在代表性方面可能需要保持一些与增强有关的差异。 在相反的方向上,Eq.49显示,一旦图像中心组织固定下来,额外的图像内部变异使得单一视角的预测更难. 因此,增量厚度是指权衡,而不是应统一尽量减少的数量。
